patch.value: Bind native lifecycle writes to locked monotonic audit coordinates

The pinned SDK ExpectedItemRevision has only id and itemHash. Its public withExpectedItemRevisions checks canonical content, not an expected history head; readHistorySnapshot is a separate read. Retain current pre/post history detection until a supported atomic monotonic contract can be consumed. Related upstream inventory: pm-cli#1587.

A same-clock ABA edit or history-only audit in the final read/write interval refuses under the same native write lock before any mutation, including each multi-event lifecycle write.; Own lifecycle events advance the expected coordinate; ordinary OS-process peer writers never inherit that authority; no compensation or history rewriting.; Certify transformed, redirected and skipped storage overrides using an artifact containing pm-cli PR1658; certify missing-capability behavior and publish exact compatibility limits.
